content.short: Baltex is a cross-chain DEX aggregator unifying DEXs and bridges into a single swap terminal.
content.description: Baltex unifies DEXs, bridges, and aggregators into a single cross-chain swap terminal, solving fragmented liquidity and cumbersome bridging. Users connect a self-custody wallet, select from 1,000+ crypto assets, and receive an optimized route with transparent fees - no app-hopping. A Private mode leverages Monero-backed infrastructure to reduce on-chain traceability. Developers can access the same routing via a single API to power in-wallet swaps with broad coverage and reliable execution.
